title: Albert's musical family and Uncle Natty Dominique
summary: Albert studied music and comes from a musical family; he talks about visiting his uncle Natty Dominique in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You learn something new every day.

You see, I studied the music, which was something in my favor. As I always said, the background of the family is very musical. My grandmother and grandfather were singers. Had a knot that played the piano. One uncle that played the violin. One played the cornet. Two of them because Natty is still living. And he doesn't play anymore. He still has his horn. But even on, we can go back and just name just schools or something that wasn't in the family that were musically inclined. And I hope that that's where I got mine from. Because I find this, that my son and my daughter doesn't even know the music. Had never been interested in it.
What about Natty? Did you know Natty Dominique when he was down here?

Oh, sure. Uncle Natty and I were, he was one of my favorite uncles. He was the younger one. Uncle Natty. And Uncle Natty went to war. And he was a mutilary in the war. And I remember the first time he came back. And he came to the estate up there on Grey Court Street. He didn't stay too long. And he left in Chicago. And I visited him quite a number of times. After I got my band. And I'd go and play up in the eastern part of the states. And Uncle Natty would be one of the first ones that I would go to see him. Samuel and Bonnie. Bonnie left a couple of years before I did in this Bonnie Biggore. Well, I'd visit Bonnie in New York or wherever I was. Right across him.
